provenance.scope: The size of each of the fourteen machines as a sentence a visitor says aloud, English and German, keyed by the machine slug of machines/catalog.ts. One sentence each: the size the machine itself has, and that the vitrine's window fits the whole of it, whatever size the screen then gives it.
provenance.rule: Every number is the `scale_m` of that machine's own record, rounded no further than the record writes it. That envelope is the size the museum's reconstruction stands at, and the record calls its dimensions modern modelling choices, so no sentence here says that a machine was ever built at this size. The card's certainty word keeps saying reconstructed beside it.
provenance.read: machines/data/<slug>.json, the `scale_m` block with its note, read 2026-09-17. The turntable frames the whole rest box of the model, so the window holds every machine whole and none of them at its own size.

aerial-screw.en: The screw is 9.5 m across and 6.1 m high, and the window here fits the whole of it, so what the screen shows is not its size.
aerial-screw.de: Die Schraube misst 9,5 m in der Breite und 6,1 m in der Höhe, und das Fenster hier fasst sie ganz, die Größe auf dem Schirm ist also nicht ihre eigene.
aerial-screw.source: machines/data/aerial-screw.json, scale_m 9.5 by 6.1 by 9.5 m, certainty C, source a-geometry

parachute.en: The parachute is 7.08 m across and 10.34 m from the floor to the top of its ropes, and the window fits all of it at once.
parachute.de: Der Fallschirm misst 7,08 m in der Breite und 10,34 m vom Boden bis zum oberen Ende der Seile, und das Fenster fasst alles auf einmal.
parachute.source: machines/data/parachute.json, scale_m 7.08 by 10.34 by 7.08 m, static envelope with the origin at the floor

anemometer.en: The instrument is 0.86 m high and 0.74 m across, and the window holds the whole of it, at whatever size the screen gives it.
anemometer.de: Das Instrument ist 0,86 m hoch und 0,74 m breit, und das Fenster zeigt es ganz, in der Größe, die der Schirm ihm gibt.
anemometer.source: machines/data/anemometer.json, scale_m 0.74 by 0.86 by 0.74 m, conservative world bounds

inclinometer.en: The inclinometer stands 0.75 m high and 0.7 m across, and the window shows the whole of it.

inclinometer.source: machines/data/inclinometer.json, scale_m 0.7 by 0.75 by 0.7 m, conservative bounds over the tilting support

multi-barrel-gun.en: The carriage is 2.5 m wide, 2.55 m high and 3.2 m from the trails to the muzzles, and the window fits the whole of it on the screen.

multi-barrel-gun.source: machines/data/multi-barrel-gun.json, scale_m 2.5 by 2.55 by 3.2 m, swept bounds with the trails at the back

rolling-mill.source: machines/data/rolling-mill.json, scale_m 1.1 by 1.1 by 0.92 m, the depth including the outer crank grip

proportional-compass.source: machines/data/proportional-compass.json, scale_m 0.4 by 0.67 by 0.08 m, smaller than every other scale_m in machines/data
